title.zh: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
title.en: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure

current_state.zh: Bernstein analysts expect the SEC and CFTC to pursue aggressive and swift rulemaking to compensate for the failed CLARITY Act, covering token taxonomy, DeFi developer protections, equity tokenization exemptions, and faster RWA perpetual futures approvals.
current_state.en: Bernstein analysts expect the SEC and CFTC to pursue aggressive and swift rulemaking to compensate for the failed CLARITY Act, covering token taxonomy, DeFi developer protections, equity tokenization exemptions, and faster RWA perpetual futures approvals.
